verdict.rationale: VLP's own Emerging Growth Companies & VC practice page says it advises start-ups on entity formation, capitalization and corporate governance, so incorporation is a documented core service. The specific deliverables in the story (charter, bylaws, initial board consents, founder stock purchase agreements) are never named, and there is no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of charter/bylaws drafting, initial board consents, founder stock purchase agreements, and independent or client corroboration of formation engagements.

support.subject: As a founder, I can engage the firm to incorporate my company — charter, bylaws, initial board consents, and founder stock purchase — documented as a core of its startup/emerging-companies practice

citations.quote: We have extensive experience advising our clients on entity formation, capitalization, corporate governance, equity compensation and capital-raising matters
VLP's Emerging Growth Companies & Venture Capital practice represents venture-backed, angel-backed and self-funded emerging growth and start-up companies across a wide range of industries.
